content: In Malachi, what does the LORD say He does not do?
explanation: So Jacob's descendants were not destroyed. “Because I, the LORD, do not change” (Malachi 3:6, BSB)

content: In Malachi, what did God tell the people to bring into the storehouse?
explanation: God promised to pour out blessing. “Bring the full tithe into the storehouse, so that there may be food in My house.” (Malachi 3:10, BSB)

content: In Malachi, what will God open to pour out blessing?
explanation: Blessing without measure. “See if I will not open the windows of heaven and pour out for you blessing without measure.” (Malachi 3:10, BSB)

content: In Malachi, which prophet will God send before the Day of the LORD?
explanation: Jesus said John the Baptist came in this role. “Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD.” (Malachi 4:5, BSB)

content: In Malachi, how did God say the people were robbing Him?
explanation: They held back what was His. “In tithes and offerings.” (Malachi 3:8, BSB)

content: In Malachi, whom will God send to prepare the way before Him?
explanation: Then the Lord would come to His temple. “Behold, I will send My messenger, who will prepare the way before Me.” (Malachi 3:1, BSB)

content: In Malachi, Elijah will turn the hearts of fathers to whom?
explanation: And children's hearts to fathers. “And he will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children” (Malachi 4:6, BSB)

content: In Malachi, what will rise with healing in its wings?
explanation: For those who fear God's name. “the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings” (Malachi 4:2, BSB)

content: In Malachi, those who fear God's name will leap like what?
explanation: Joy follows healing. “and you will go out and leap like calves from the stall.” (Malachi 4:2, BSB)

content: In Malachi, when God says “I have loved you,” whose brother does He mention?
explanation: God chose to love Jacob. “Was not Esau Jacob’s brother?” (Malachi 1:2, BSB)
